info.title: RaceDay API
info.description: API for managing races: events, categories, enrolments and results.

post.description: The role is always Participant. Organisers are created by the system, not through this endpoint.

requestBody.description: Name, email and a password of at least 6 characters.

201.description: Account created. Returns the user (no password).

post.summary: Logs in and starts a session.
post.description: The session stores the user's ID and role for all later requests.

200.description: Logged in. Returns the user and their role.

post.summary: Logs out and clears the session.
post.description: Safe to call even if you are not logged in.

get.summary: Lists all categories for one event.

post.summary: Adds a category to an event.
post.description: Organisers only, and only for events they created.

requestBody.description: Category name, distance in km, entry fee and max participants.

403.description: Not an Organiser, or not the owner of this event.

put.description: Organisers only, and only for events they created.

403.description: Not an Organiser, or not the owner of this event.

delete.description: Organisers only, and only for events they created.

403.description: Not an Organiser, or not the owner of this event.

post.summary: Enrols the logged-in Participant into a category.
post.description: Participants only. Fails if the category doesn't exist, is full, or you are already enrolled.

requestBody.description: The ID of the category to join.

400.description: Category doesn't exist or is full.

get.summary: Lists the logged-in Participant's own enrolments.
get.description: Participants only. You only ever see your own enrolments.

get.summary: Lists everyone enrolled in an event.
get.description: Organisers only, and only for events they created.

200.description: Array of enrolments with participant details.

403.description: Not an Organiser, or not the owner of this event.

delete.summary: Cancels the logged-in Participant's own enrolment.
delete.description: Participants only, and only their own enrolments.

403.description: Not a Participant, or not your enrolment.

get.description: Public, no login needed. Only events from today onwards are returned.

post.description: Organisers only. The event is linked to the logged-in Organiser automatically.

requestBody.description: Event name, date, location, and optional description and route map link.

403.description: Logged in, but not an Organiser.

get.summary: Gets the full details of one event.

put.description: Organisers only, and only the Organiser who created the event.

403.description: Not an Organiser, or not the owner of this event.

delete.description: Organisers only, and only the Organiser who created the event.

403.description: Not an Organiser, or not the owner of this event.

get.summary: Organiser's own events, including past ones.

post.summary: Uploads a banner image for one of the organiser's events.
Captures a race result for an enrolment.
post.description: Organisers only, and only for events they created. One result per enrolment.

requestBody.description: Finish time (hh:mm:ss), position, and status (Finished, DNF, DNS or DSQ).

403.description: Not an Organiser, or not the owner of this event.

409.description: A result already exists for this enrolment.

put.description: Organisers only, and only for events they created.

requestBody.description: The new finish time, position and status.

403.description: Not an Organiser, or not the owner of this event.

get.summary: Shows the logged-in Participant's own results history.
get.description: Participants only. You only ever see your own results.
Public, no login needed. Sorted by position, with unplaced results last.

get.summary: Returns the logged-in user's own profile.
get.description: Any logged-in user (Organiser or Participant). The user is found from the session.

put.summary: Updates the logged-in user's name and phone.
put.description: Any logged-in user. Email and role cannot be changed here.

requestBody.description: New name and an optional phone number.
